readings: Looking only at tracks that have a matching media type, for each media type name compute bytes per millisecond as the ratio of totals: SUM(Bytes) divided by SUM(Milliseconds) over all of that media type's tracks. Also show that figure divided by the simple average of these per-media-type figures (each media type counted once). Leave the numbers unrounded.

Looking only at tracks that have a matching media type, for each media type name compute bytes per millisecond as the average of the per-track ratios: AVG(Bytes / Milliseconds) over that media type's tracks. Also show that figure divided by the simple average of these per-media-type figures (each media type counted once). Leave the numbers unrounded.
queries:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bpm
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name, bpm, bpm / (SELECT AVG(bpm) FROM per) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM per;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS Name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMs
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT Name, BytesPerMs, BytesPerMs / (SELECT AVG(BytesPerMs) FROM m) AS RatioToAverage
FROM m
